scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/prisma/seed.ts backend/tests tests scripts docs README.md
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
